Photo 2 shows a stack of multiple wooden pallets in an outdoor or semi-outdoor environment.

risks.proof: A photo of the specific pallet being sold alongside a photo of the stack.

risks.risk: The pallets in the stack may be infested with termites or have hidden structural damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside and the joints of the pallets.

proof_requests: Photo of the specific pallet being sold.
Photo of the underside of the pallet.
